initial.instructions: Within ou=People,dc=delegation,dc=test, let every established person update only their own mail and description. Let uid=desk,ou=Service,dc=delegation,dc=test update description there, including other people, but never mail. Deny all other writes, including Archive and Service changes. A denied multi-field request must change nothing. Preserve every unrelated entry and value across all samples.
initial.starter: access to * by users write by * none
initial.reference:
access to dn.subtree="ou=People,dc=delegation,dc=test" attrs=description
    by dn.exact="uid=desk,ou=Service,dc=delegation,dc=test" write
    by self write
    by * none
access to dn.subtree="ou=People,dc=delegation,dc=test" attrs=mail
    by self write
    by * none
access to * by * none
